observations: Large upright 4-door industrial freezer or refrigerator.
Two right-side doors are open; two left-side doors are closed.
Interior appears to be reflective metal, likely stainless steel.
Digital control panel with two displays and two knobs at the top center.
The unit is mounted on four caster wheels.
Exterior finish is white or light grey.
The appliance is positioned outdoors on uneven, dry dirt ground.
Watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI' and 'DIVINE FAVOUR' is visible on the image.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows a 4-door upright commercial-style cooling unit.
Efficiency and durability cannot be assessed from a static photo.
Requires a photo of the warranty certificate or a formal receipt from a registered business.

risks.proof: A video of the unit powered on with the digital display showing a temperature drop to freezing levels.

risks.risk: Generic or low-quality brand affecting longevity
risks.proof: A clear photo of the manufacturer's data plate showing the brand and model.

risks.risk: Damaged door seals or missing internal shelving
risks.proof: Photos of all door gaskets and the full interior with all shelves installed.

proof_requests: Photo of the manufacturer's identification plate showing the brand, model, and technical specs.
Video of the unit running, showing the temperature on the digital controller.
Photos of the interior with all doors open to see the condition of the shelves and seals.
Photo of the warranty document mentioned in the description.
response.reason: The brand and model are critical for pricing industrial equipment and are not visible in the photo. Furthermore, the unit being stored outdoors on dirt is a significant risk to its mechanical condition.
